title: 第14章
content_zh:
轻轻的拍了拍夏真钰的脸叫她：真钰、真钰，醒醒。
夏真钰躲着他的手，身子赶往下滑，周瑾宇连忙让她躺下，头枕在自己的腿上，拨开她的头发，叹息了一声，用自己温热的手来回抚＼摸夏真钰的脸颊，对司机说了夏真钰家的地址。
到了小区门口，想叫醒夏真钰问她具体门牌号，夏真钰迷迷糊糊的嘀咕着头晕、难受什么的，就是不理周瑾宇的话。
周瑾宇本想找出夏真钰的手机打给她丈夫，可刚想拿过夏真钰的包却又停住了，看着夏真钰一个劲的往自己身上蹭，想找个舒适的位置，他的心就被填满了，看了眼夏真钰家小区的大门，说了声：回尚林苑。
作者有话要说：光光回家紧急码了这一章，立即发了出来，高兴不？
昨天抽时间研究了下其他作者的肉文，有感慨啊，有了悟，神马不要啊、太深啦、慢一点、受不了啦这些才是肉文的万金油啊，不会被锁，而且放之言情、耽美、百合、穿越、重生、古代、现代等所有文皆可，受教了！
☆、不清不楚
周瑾宇在尚林苑的房子是单体别墅式的，等车开进车库后周瑾宇就让司机回去了，自己打横抱起夏真钰进了屋子，把她放在二楼主卧的床上，帮她脱了鞋子。
周瑾宇想了想还是让夏真钰脱了衣服睡比较舒服，于是又把她扶了起来，自己也上了床开始解夏真钰的衣扣，随着夏真钰衣服的减少，雪白的肌肤也逐渐暴＼露出来，直到身上已经只剩内衣了，周瑾宇的手却仍在夏真钰的身上流连着。
周瑾宇俯□去，不断亲吻着夏真玉的眉眼和脸颊，最后停留在她水润的红唇上不肯离去，其实他并没打算趁人之危，只是吻着吻就有些情不自禁，轻捏夏真钰的下颚，让她的双唇微张，好让自己加深这个吻。
轻轻的碰触着夏真钰的丁香小舌，周瑾宇吻得投入、吻得忘情，根本没注意到夏真钰越皱越紧的眉头。夏真钰觉得自己呼吸异常困难，身体像坐云霄飞车一样随时都可能掉下去，双手却抓不住任何能稳住自己的东西，反胃的感觉一直在，她听说喝完酒再吐是非常伤身体的，可忍了半天实在是忍不住了，大力的推开压在自己身上的东西，然后直接吐了。
周瑾宇强忍着自己也想吐的感觉，先把夏真钰抱进洗手间，然后闭着眼睛一把将床上的床单、被褥连着夏真钰的衣服胡乱的卷在一起直接扔到门外的走廊上。
然后自己把外套也脱了，回到洗手间准备开始帮夏真钰清洗，结果一进去就看见夏真钰自己已经洗了脸，老老实实的坐在马桶上。
周市长，我怎么会在这里，我的衣服呢？夏真钰看着周瑾宇问道。
周瑾宇有些尴尬，他没想到夏真钰突然一下子就清醒了，也不知道该怎么解释自己的行为，于是只能说：你先等会儿，我给你拿件衣服。然后找了件自己的睡衣给夏真钰。
夏真钰接过睡衣穿上了，周瑾宇宽大的睡衣一下就盖到了她的膝盖。接着夏真钰表情严肃的想了想，又说：周市长谢谢您。嗯，今晚我们全体现同志都非常高兴，时间不早了，我先告辞了，你们慢慢喝。
说完从马桶上站了起来快步出了洗手间，周瑾宇没明白夏真钰这是演的哪一出，但也不可能让她三更半夜的穿着睡衣出大门，于是跟在夏真钰的后面看她要做什么。
夏真钰在卧室里找了半天，好像没找到自己要的东西，出了卧室直接下了楼梯，又在一楼客厅里找，周瑾宇看着夏真钰终于在沙发上找到了她的包，然后斜挎在肩上，绕过自己又上了二楼，回到卧室，把包又扔在了小沙发上，便直接爬上＼床说了句：李巍，我喝多了，刚才还吐了，现在头晕得很你别和我说话了，明天再说！然后就闭上眼睛呼吸平稳的睡着了。
周瑾宇憋了半天，终于哈哈大笑起来，夏真钰这个活宝，就是喝醉了也一样能让自己如此开心，笑了好一阵子才停下，嘴边却一直挂着笑意，走回床边看了一会儿夏真钰熟睡的脸，又找来上床薄被给她盖上，自己则去了客房。
离开时周瑾宇已经想明白了，其实只要能让夏真钰心甘情愿，自己是非常愿意和她成为情人的，这事儿只要夏真钰看开，其实既不会影响她的婚姻，又能让她在工作上一帆风顺，那么现在的问题就是让夏真钰点头而已。

夏真钰坐在床上看着只穿一条睡裤走进来的周瑾宇，只恨自己千防万防却在昨天大意了，本想着那么多人在，还有自己单位的领导就算自己喝醉了，也能送自己回家或者给李巍打个电话什么的，没想到他们却直接把自己扔给了周瑾宇。
还好周瑾宇算是个君子，没对自己怎么样。顾不上欣赏对方修长挺拔的身材，夏真钰冷静的说道：我的衣服呢？
周瑾宇走近坐在床边看着夏真钰坏笑：你怎么不问昨晚发生了什么？
夏真钰没好气的看了他一眼：你是当我有多无知，连发自己发生了什么事情都不知道？
周瑾宇好心情的逗她：你已经醉到人事不醒了，又怎么知道没发生什么，也许已经发生了而我只不过事后清理好罢了。
夏真钰轻蔑的笑了下：随你怎么想，我自己心里有数就好，发没发生什么事你我彼此都心知肚明。
周瑾宇没想到夏真钰如此冷静和肯定，还真不清楚她的这份自信是哪来的。
夏真钰想着要是自己已经不是第一次的话，也许周瑾宇还能吓唬自己一下，可她到现在还没和男人有过真正的亲密行为，那么对于周瑾宇到底做没做过什么当然清楚得很。
周瑾宇这时笑着说：你昨天吐在床上了，衣服也全都脏了，早上我让人送洗衣店去了，本想给你买新的，不过想着你回家可能不方便解释就没买，你先穿我的睡衣吧，早饭已经做好了，你洗漱完了就下楼来吃。说完伸手顺了顺夏真钰有些乱的头发，然后就出了卧室。
夏真钰没心情理会他的小动作，现在最担心的是怎么和李巍解释自己一晚上没回家的事情，穿上睡衣看见自己的包就在一边的沙发上，找出手机看到１６个未接电话和８条短信。
先看了未接来电大部分都是李巍的，还有几个是王姐打来的，又开始看信息，除了李巍的也有王姐发的，李巍的信息内容都是让她回电话，问她什么时候回来，语气越来越急。
又看了王姐的信息，结果王姐大概的意思就是昨晚李巍找不到她就给王姐打了电话，王姐怕有什么误会就说饭局还没完，大家都喝了不少，夏真钰已经醉得不行了，估计得和她一起住宾馆，第二天直接上班。
后来王姐又发了一条信息，说怕穿帮还给郭主任也打了个电话问起夏真钰的去向，也和他说了李巍找夏真钰的事情，结果郭主任说自己也喝多了，但保证夏真钰肯定没事儿，如果李巍也给他打电话，他会和王姐说辞一样。
最后一条是郭主任的，告诉夏真钰今天可以休息不用去上班。
夏真钰看完知道就算自己真没和周瑾宇发生什么关系，不过在别人眼里特别是郭主任眼里也已经不清不楚了。
先给王姐打了电话，很快就有人接了：真钰啊，你昨天去哪了啊？你家李巍给我打电话，我都不知道怎么说，只能那么编瞎话儿了，还好郭主任帮忙配合要不就交待不过去了。
叹了口气，夏真钰还是和王姐说了实话：王姐，我现在是彻底说不清楚了，昨晚我喝醉了以为郭主任能送我回家，没想到最后是周瑾宇送的我。
啊？你说是周市长送的你，可你也没回家啊！王姐很吃惊，虽然昨天看出了那些人的意图，可没想到出手会如此之快。
他没送我回家，估计是不知道地址，也不好给李巍打电话，我在他家呢，不过什么也没发生，王姐别人如何我管不了，可你得相信我。夏真钰觉得也只能和王姐解释一二了。
唉，真钰，我听你的语气也知道没什么事儿，可是你知道不知道——，算了不说了，王姐只能说不管到什么时候只要你能把握住自己，就算别人再如何也不能强迫你，你明白吗？

我知道，王姐，我以后一定提高警惕，不过郭主任倒还真肯帮忙。
王姐一听夏真钰的话就知道她根本还没意识到事情的真实情况，防人也没防在重点上，只防周瑾宇一个人有什么用，郭主任和周瑾宇身边的人才更应该防，周瑾宇好歹身份地位摆在那儿，做事不会出大格儿，可那些人为了讨好周瑾宇什么手段都会用的。
不过自己也不可能再多说什么了，毕竟自己不可能为夏真钰去得罪领导，只能言尽于此了。
挂了电话，夏真钰又给李巍打过去，李巍语气有些抱怨：真钰，就算你不能回来也应该提前给我打个电话说一声啊，你知道昨天我打了多少个电话找你，你就是不接，还好我有王姐的电话，不然我都得报警去了。
对不起啊，李巍，真的对不起，下次一定不会了。夏真钰觉得有愧连连道歉。
李巍听了语也气缓和了：算了，下次注意就行了。昨天王姐还让我给你们郭主任打电话呢，我怕对你影响不好没打，你今天还得上班吗？
夏真钰只能撒谎了：是啊，一会儿我和王姐还有其他同事一起去单位，今晚估计能早些回去。
那行，你一定得吃早饭啊，不然胃受不了。李巍又叮嘱了几句才挂了电话。
在屋子里站了一会儿，夏真钰开门下楼，找到餐厅时看见桌子上已经摆好了粥还有一些清淡的小菜，这时周瑾宇又端了一盘馒头放在了桌上说道：给家里打过电话了？
content_en:
He gently patted Xia Zhenyu's face and called her: Zhenyu, Zhenyu, wake up.
Xia Zhenyu avoided his hand and slid down. Zhou Jinyu quickly let her lie down with her head on his lap, pushed her hair away, sighed, stroked Xia Zhenyu's cheek back and forth with his warm hands, and told the driver the address of Xia Zhenyu's home.
When he arrived at the gate of the community, he wanted to wake Xia Zhenyu up and ask her for her specific house number. Xia Zhenyu mumbled about being dizzy and uncomfortable, but ignored Zhou Jinyu's words.
Zhou Jinyu originally wanted to find Xia Zhenyu's cell phone and call her husband, but he stopped when he just wanted to take Xia Zhenyu's bag. Watching Xia Zhenyu keep rubbing against him, trying to find a comfortable position, his heart was filled. He glanced at the gate of Xia Zhenyu's community and said: Go back to Shanglinyuan.
The author has something to say: Guangguang urgently coded this chapter when he returned home and posted it immediately. Are you happy?
Yesterday I took the time to study other authors' pornographic novels. I felt emotional and gained the understanding. Don't let it go, it's too deep, slow down, and you can't stand it. These are the panacea for erotic novels. They will not be locked and can be used for all kinds of romance, Danmei, Lily, time travel, rebirth, ancient, modern, etc. I have learned a lesson!
☆、Unclear
Zhou Jinyu's house in Shanglinyuan was a single villa. After the car drove into the garage, Zhou Jinyu asked the driver to go back. He carried Xia Zhenyu into the house, put her on the bed in the master bedroom on the second floor, and helped her take off her shoes.
Zhou Jinyu thought for a while and let Xia Zhenyu take off her clothes to sleep more comfortably, so he helped her up and went to bed and began to unbutton Xia Zhenyu's clothes. As Xia Zhenyu's clothes decreased, her white skin was gradually exposed, until only her underwear was left on her body, but Zhou Jinyu's hands were still lingering on Xia Zhenyu's body.
Zhou Jinyu leaned forward and kept kissing Xia Zhenyu's eyebrows and cheeks, finally lingering on her moist red lips and refusing to leave. In fact, he had no intention of taking advantage of her, but he couldn't help but kiss her. He gently pinched Xia Zhenyu's chin and opened her lips slightly so that he could deepen the kiss.
Gently touching Xia Zhenyu's lilac uvula, Zhou Jinyu kissed her so passionately that he didn't even notice Xia Zhenyu's frown getting tighter. Xia Zhenyu felt that it was extremely difficult to breathe. Her body was like a roller coaster and she might fall at any time. However, her hands could not grasp anything that could stabilize her. The feeling of nausea persisted. She heard that vomiting after drinking wine was very harmful to the body, but after enduring it for a long time, she couldn't bear it any longer. She pushed away the things pressing on her body vigorously, and then vomited directly.
Zhou Jinyu resisted the feeling of wanting to vomit, first carried Xia Zhenyu into the bathroom, then with his eyes closed, he rolled up the sheets and quilts on the bed and Xia Zhenyu's clothes and threw them directly into the corridor outside the door.
Then he took off his coat and returned to the bathroom to start cleaning Xia Zhenyu. As soon as he entered, he saw that Xia Zhenyu had already washed his face and was sitting on the toilet.
Mayor Zhou, why am I here? Where are my clothes? Xia Zhenyu looked at Zhou Jinyu and asked.
Zhou Jinyu was a little embarrassed. He didn't expect Xia Zhenyu to wake up suddenly, and he didn't know how to explain his behavior, so he could only say: "Wait a moment, I will get you some clothes." Then he found his own pajamas for Xia Zhenyu.
Xia Zhenyu took her pajamas and put them on. Zhou Jinyu's large pajamas immediately covered her knees. Then Xia Zhenyu thought about it with a serious expression, and then said: Mayor Zhou, thank you. Well, all of us comrades are very happy tonight. It's getting late, so I'll take my leave now and you can drink slowly.
After saying that, he stood up from the toilet and hurried out of the bathroom. Zhou Jinyu didn't understand what Xia Zhenyu was acting in, but it was impossible for her to go out in the middle of the night in pajamas, so he followed Xia Zhenyu to see what she was going to do.What?
Xia Zhenyu searched in the bedroom for a long time, but didn't seem to find what she wanted. After leaving the bedroom, she went down the stairs and then searched in the living room on the first floor. Zhou Jinyu watched as Xia Zhenyu finally found her bag on the sofa and slung it over her shoulder. He went up, bypassed himself and went up to the second floor, returned to the bedroom, threw his bag on the small sofa again, climbed directly onto the bed and said: Li Wei, I drank too much, I vomited just now, and now I'm very dizzy. Don't talk to me. We'll talk to you tomorrow! Then he closed his eyes and breathed steadily and fell asleep.
Zhou Jinyu held it in for a long time and finally burst out laughing. Xia Zhenyu, a living treasure, could still make herself so happy even when she was drunk. She laughed for a while before stopping, but with a smile on her lips. She walked back to the bed and looked at Xia Zhenyu's sleeping face for a while, then found the bed sheet and covered her with it, and then went to the guest room.
When she left, Zhou Jinyu had already figured it out. In fact, as long as Xia Zhenyu could make her willing, he was very willing to become her lover. As long as Xia Zhenyu looked away from this matter, it would not affect her marriage and make her work smoothly. So the problem now was to get Xia Zhenyu to nod.
Xia Zhenyu sat on the bed and looked at Zhou Jinyu who walked in wearing only a pair of pajamas. He only regretted that he had taken all precautions but was careless yesterday. He had thought that there were so many people here and the leaders of his own unit could send him home or call Li Wei even if he was drunk. Unexpectedly, they just left him to Zhou Jinyu.
Fortunately, Zhou Jinyu was a gentleman and didn't do anything to him. Ignoring admiring the other person's slender and tall figure, Xia Zhenyu said calmly: Where are my clothes?
Zhou Jinyu walked over and sat on the edge of the bed, looking at Xia Zhenyu with a wicked smile: Why didn't you ask what happened last night?
Xia Zhenyu glanced at him angrily: Do you think I am so ignorant that I don't even know what happened to me?
Zhou Jinyu teased her in a good mood: You are so drunk that you are unconscious. How do you know that nothing happened? Maybe it has happened and I just cleaned up afterward.
Xia Zhenyu smiled contemptuously: "Whatever you think, I just know what happened. You and I both know what happened."
Zhou Jinyu didn't expect Xia Zhenyu to be so calm and sure, and he really didn't know where her confidence came from.
Xia Zhenyu thought that if it wasn't her first time, maybe Zhou Jinyu could scare her a little bit, but she had never had real intimacy with a man so far, so of course she knew very well whether Zhou Jinyu had done anything.
Zhou Jinyu smiled and said: You vomited on the bed yesterday, and your clothes were all dirty. I sent someone to the laundry this morning. I wanted to buy you new ones, but I thought it might be inconvenient for you to explain when you got home, so I didn’t buy them. You can wear my pajamas first. Breakfast is already prepared. Come downstairs to eat after you wash up. After saying that, he stretched out his hand to smooth Shun Xia Zhenyu's messy hair, and then left the bedroom.
Xia Zhenyu was in no mood to pay attention to his little actions. What she was most worried about now was how to explain to Li Wei that she hadn't gone home all night. She put on her pajamas and saw her bag on the sofa beside her. She found her cell phone and saw 16 missed calls and 8 text messages.
First I looked at the missed calls, most of them were from Li Wei, and a few were from Sister Wang. Then I started to look at the messages. In addition to Li Wei's messages, there were also messages from Sister Wang. Li Wei's messages all asked her to call her back and asked her when she would be back. His tone became more and more urgent.
After reading Sister Wang's message again, it turned out that Sister Wang probably meant that Li Wei couldn't find her last night and called Sister Wang. Sister Wang was afraid of any misunderstanding, so she said that the dinner was not over yet. Everyone drank a lot. Xia Zhenyu was already very drunk. She probably had to stay in the hotel with her and go to work directly the next day.
Later, Sister Wang sent another message, saying that she was afraid of being cheated, so she called Director Guo and asked about Xia Zhenyu’s whereabouts, and also told him about LiWei asked about Xia Zhenyu, but Director Guo said that he had drunk too much, but assured that Xia Zhenyu would be fine. If Li Wei also called him, he would say the same thing as Sister Wang.
The last message was from Director Guo, telling Xia Zhenyu that he could take a break today and not go to work.
After reading it, Xia Zhenyu realized that even if he really had no relationship with Zhou Jinyu, it would still be unclear in the eyes of others, especially Director Guo.
I called Sister Wang first, and someone quickly answered: Zhenyu, where were you yesterday? When your Li Wei called me, I didn't know what to say. I could only make up lies. Fortunately, Director Guo helped me to cooperate, otherwise I wouldn't be able to explain it.
Sighing, Xia Zhenyu told the truth to Sister Wang: Sister Wang, I can't explain it at all now. I was drunk last night and thought Director Guo could send me home. Unexpectedly, it was Zhou Jinyu who sent me home.
ah? You said Mayor Zhou gave it to you, but you didn’t go home either! Sister Wang was surprised. Although she saw the intentions of those people yesterday, she did not expect that they would take action so quickly.
He didn't send me home, probably because he didn't know the address and couldn't call Li Wei. I was at his house, but nothing happened. I can't control what happens to others, Sister Wang, but you have to believe me. Xia Zhenyu felt that she could only explain something to Sister Wang.
Alas, Zhenyu, I know from your tone that nothing is wrong, but do you know——, forget it, Sister Wang can only say that no matter when you can control yourself, no matter what others do, they can't force you, do you understand?
I know, Sister Wang, I will have to be more vigilant in the future, but Director Guo is really willing to help.
As soon as Sister Wang heard Xia Zhenyu's words, she knew that she had not realized the true situation of the matter at all, and guarding against people was not the main point. What was the use of guarding against Zhou Jinyu alone? Director Guo and the talents around Zhou Jinyu should be guarded even more. After all, Zhou Jinyu's status was there and he would not act out of style, but those people would use any means to please Zhou Jinyu.
But he couldn't say anything more. After all, he couldn't offend the leader for Xia Zhenyu, so he could only say this.
After hanging up the phone, Xia Zhenyu called Li Wei again. Li Wei sounded complaining: Zhenyu, even if you can't come back, you should call me in advance to say something. Do you know how many calls I made to you yesterday, but you just didn't answer. Fortunately, I have Sister Wang's phone number, otherwise I would have to call the police.
I'm sorry, Li Wei. I'm really sorry. I won't do it next time. Xia Zhenyu felt ashamed and apologized repeatedly.
Li Wei softened after hearing this: Forget it, just pay attention next time. Yesterday, Sister Wang asked me to call your Director Guo. I was afraid that it would have a bad impact on you, so I didn’t call. Do you still have to go to work today?
Xia Zhenyu could only lie: Yes, I will go to the unit with Sister Wang and other colleagues in a while. I think I can go back early tonight.
That's okay, you must have breakfast, otherwise your stomach won't be able to bear it. Li Wei said a few more words before hanging up the phone.
After standing in the room for a while, Xia Zhenyu opened the door and went downstairs. When he found the restaurant, he saw porridge and some light side dishes on the table. At this time, Zhou Jinyu put another plate of steamed buns on the table and said: Have you called home?
